headline: GPT-5.6 Sol emerges with frontier capabilities and efficiency gains
body: OpenAI's latest model iteration, GPT-5.6 Sol, has entered circulation across developer communities with demonstrated gains in both performance and computational efficiency. The model is showing capability across diverse use cases, from complex 3D rendering tasks to specialized domain applications. For healthcare AI implementations, frontier models with improved efficiency directly impact deployment costs in resource-constrained clinical environments and enable more sophisticated real-time clinical decision support without proportional infrastructure scaling. Consulting teams should reassess current model selection strategies for EHR integration and clinical workflow automation, as efficiency gains may unlock previously unfeasible implementations in mid-sized health systems. The velocity of adoption signals a narrowing window for vendors still operating on earlier model generations.
